• Unordered, records/s at workMicros 0 / 100 / 1000: KPipe 814k / 533k / 516k, Atleon 561k / 467k / 461k, raw 902k / 617k / 626k.
• KPipe ÷ Atleon: 1.45x / 1.14x / 1.12x unordered, 1.12x / 1.06x / 0.92x per key. KPipe ÷ raw: 0.90x / 0.86x / 0.82x.
• gc.count and gc.time are totals for the measurement window, so faster arms run more invocations and collect more.
Per-partition arms and the single-threaded baseline are omitted: different guarantee. Full table: benchmarks/results/2026-10-15-ci-parallel.md
